composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# Runs first. When the 'Idempotency-Key' header repeats a key already seen, short-circuit with a
# 200 replay of the originally created owner (before the duplicate check below would 409); otherwise
# publish the key for RecordIdempotency and continue building.
checkIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckIdempotency
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

# Assign the deterministic householdId (SHA-256 over lastName + postcode). It no longer drives
# duplicate detection; it is retained for household-size and membership derivations. Owners at the
# same last name and postcode are the same household.
assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureUniqueIdentity

# The single duplicate block: reject a second owner whose identityKey (SHA-256 over normalized
# telephone + lower-case email + soundex of the last name) matches an existing one with 409, unless
# the request set 'sharesHousehold' to declare it a household member.
ensureUniqueIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureUniqueIdentity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignMemberId

assignMemberId:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignMemberId
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignNamesakeCount

assignNamesakeCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignNamesakeCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureCityCapacity

ensureCityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureCityCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureDailyOwnerLimit

ensureDailyOwnerLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureDailyOwnerLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignPossibleDuplicate

# Soft match: flag an owner whose identityKey differs from an existing one but whose soundex(lastName)
# and postcode match. A declared household member ('sharesHousehold') is never flagged.
assignPossibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: recordIdempotency

# Owner is now persisted (id assigned); remember it against the Idempotency-Key (if any) so a repeat
# replays this owner. No-op when the request carried no key.
recordIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RecordIdempotency
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: notify

# Owner is persisted with its memberId assigned; enqueue a welcome notification carrying the owner
# id and the memberId to the dedicated NOTIFY logger.
notify:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnqueueWelcomeNotification
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

content.text:
I now have the full pipeline. Here is every validation and side-effect applied by `POST /api/owners`, in execution order.

## Pre-pipeline

1. **Authorization** (`owners.POST.yml` `composition.authorize`): caller must satisfy `hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')`, else `AuthorizationDeniedException` (403). Applies before any step runs.

The whole pipeline runs under a single write transaction (`govern: [ transaction ]` on every step), committed once at the end.

## Step 1 — `CheckIdempotency`
- Reads the optional `Idempotency-Key` header and **publishes it** as a variable (`Out<String>`) for later recording.
- If the key was already seen: loads the originally-created owner and throws `IdempotentReplayException`, short-circuiting to a **200 replay** (no new owner created). This deliberately runs *before* the duplicate check so a repeat gives 200, not 409.
- Note: this runs *before* body validation — a replayed request never validates its body.

## Step 2 — `BuildOwner` (binds `@RequestBody @Valid`, the only body-reading step)
Applied in this internal order:
- **Bean validation** on `OwnerFieldsDto` (`@Valid`, runs before the method body): `firstName`/`lastName` `@NotNull`, name `@Pattern`, `@Size(1..30)`; `city` `@NotNull @Size(1..80)`; `telephone` `@NotNull @Size(1..20)`; `address` `@Size(1..255)`; `addressLine1`/`addressLine2` `@Size(max 255)`; `email` `@Email @Size(max 255)`; `postcode` `@Pattern ^[0-9]{4}$`; `title` enum. Failure → `MethodArgumentNotValidException` (400).
- **Side-effect:** publishes the request-only `sharesHousehold` flag as a variable.
- **Side-effect:** normalizes address fields — `addressLine1`/`addressLine2` normalized (trim, collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand ST/RD/AVE), then composes the effective `address` (structured lines preferred over flat).
- **Validation:** required-field check on the *composed* result — `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, `telephone` must be non-blank → `MissingOwnerFieldsException` if any missing.
- **Side-effect + validation:** normalizes `telephone` to E.164 (assumes `+61`, drops leading `0`, strips separators; enforces 8–15 digits and per-country national length) → `InvalidTelephoneException`.
- **Side-effect + validation:** normalizes optional `email` to lower-case; syntactic check and disposable-domain rejection (`mailinator.com`/`tempmail.com`/`guerrillamail.com`) → `InvalidEmailException`.
- **Validation:** optional `postcode` must fall in the city's region range (NSW/VIC/QLD); unknown region accepts any 4-digit → `InvalidPostcodeException`.
- **Side-effect:** maps DTO → `Owner` entity.
- **Validation:** supplied `registrationDate` may not be in the future → `FutureRegistrationDateException`; if absent, defaults to today.
- **Side-effect:** rolls `registrationDate` forward to the next non-holiday business day and stores it. Publishes the built `Owner`.

## Step 3 — `AssignHousehold`
- **Side-effect:** sets deterministic `householdId` = SHA-256(lastName + postcode) (first 12 hex). Unconditional; used only for household-size/membership derivations now, not duplicate detection.

## Step 4 — `EnsureUniqueIdentity` (the hard duplicate check)
- **Validation:** unless `sharesHousehold` is true, rejects with `DuplicateIdentityException` (409) if any existing non-soft-deleted owner has the same `identityKey` = SHA-256(identifierRegion + normalized telephone + lower email + soundex(lastName)). Declared household members bypass this.

## Step 5 — `AssignMemberId`
- **Side-effect:** computes `memberId` (`<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`); on collision with an existing `memberId`, appends `-2`, `-3`, … until unique. Sets it on the owner.

## Step 6 — `AssignNamesakeCount`
- **Side-effect:** sets `namesakeCount` = number of existing owners sharing first+last name (case-insensitive).

## Step 7 — `EnsureCityCapacity`
- **Validation:** rejects with `CityAtCapacityException` if the owner's city (normalized, case-insensitive) already has ≥ 50 owners.

## Step 8 — `EnsureDailyOwnerLimit`
- **Validation:** rejects with `DailyOwnerLimitException` if ≥ 100 existing owners share this owner's (adjusted) `registrationDate`.

## Step 9 — `AssignPossibleDuplicate` (soft match)
- **Side-effect:** unless `sharesHousehold` is true, flags `possibleDuplicate = true` and `possibleDuplicateOf = <earliest matching id>` when an existing non-deleted owner has a *different* identityKey but the *same* soundex(lastName) and postcode; otherwise sets `possibleDuplicate = false`.

## Step 10 — `SaveOwner`
- **Side-effect:** persists the owner via `OwnerRepository.save` (assigns the DB id).

## Step 11 — `RecordIdempotency`
- **Side-effect:** if the request carried an `Idempotency-Key`, records `key → owner.id` in the `IdempotencyStore` so a repeat replays this owner. No-op when no key.

## Step 12 — `AuditOwnerCreated`
- **Side-effect:** computes membership points and capped level; emits a human-readable audit line **and** a structured schema-v2 `OwnerCreatedEvent` JSON (allocating a monotonic app-wide `seq`) to the `AUDIT` logger.

## Step 13 — `EnqueueWelcomeNotification`
- **Side-effect:** emits a welcome line (`id`, `memberId`) to the `NOTIFY` logger.

## Step 14 — `RespondWithOwnerCreated`
- **Side-effect:** maps the owner to `OwnerDto` and sends **201 Created** with `Location: /api/owners/{id}`.

---

Two things worth flagging while reading it as-is:
- The idempotency replay in step 1 happens **before** body validation (step 2), so a replayed key returns the stored owner without re-validating the (possibly different) body.
- The `sharesHousehold` DTO doc says it bypasses duplicates for "same last name and postcode," but the actual hard check it bypasses (`EnsureUniqueIdentity`) keys on telephone + email + soundex(lastName), not last name + postcode — the last-name/postcode notion now only drives the *soft* match in step 9.

- **Validation:** required-field check on the *composed* result — `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, `telephone` must be non-blank → `MissingOwnerFieldsException` if any missing.
- **Side-effect + validation:** normalizes `telephone` to E.164 (assumes `+61`, drops leading `0`, strips separators; enforces 8–15 digits and per-country national length) → `InvalidTelephoneException`.
- **Side-effect + validation:** normalizes optional `email` to lower-case; syntactic check and disposable-domain rejection (`mailinator.com`/`tempmail.com`/`guerrillamail.com`) → `InvalidEmailException`.
- **Validation:** optional `postcode` must fall in the city's region range (NSW/VIC/QLD); unknown region accepts any 4-digit → `InvalidPostcodeException`.
- **Side-effect:** maps DTO → `Owner` entity.
- **Validation:** supplied `registrationDate` may not be in the future → `FutureRegistrationDateException`; if absent, defaults to today.
- **Side-effect:** rolls `registrationDate` forward to the next non-holiday business day and stores it. Publishes the built `Owner`.

## Step 3 — `AssignHousehold`
- **Side-effect:** sets deterministic `householdId` = SHA-256(lastName + postcode) (first 12 hex). Unconditional; used only for household-size/membership derivations now, not duplicate detection.

## Step 4 — `EnsureUniqueIdentity` (the hard duplicate check)
- **Validation:** unless `sharesHousehold` is true, rejects with `DuplicateIdentityException` (409) if any existing non-soft-deleted owner has the same `identityKey` = SHA-256(identifierRegion + normalized telephone + lower email + soundex(lastName)). Declared household members bypass this.

## Step 5 — `AssignMemberId`
- **Side-effect:** computes `memberId` (`<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`); on collision with an existing `memberId`, appends `-2`, `-3`, … until unique. Sets it on the owner.

## Step 6 — `AssignNamesakeCount`
- **Side-effect:** sets `namesakeCount` = number of existing owners sharing first+last name (case-insensitive).

## Step 7 — `EnsureCityCapacity`
- **Validation:** rejects with `CityAtCapacityException` if the owner's city (normalized, case-insensitive) already has ≥ 50 owners.

## Step 8 — `EnsureDailyOwnerLimit`
- **Validation:** rejects with `DailyOwnerLimitException` if ≥ 100 existing owners share this owner's (adjusted) `registrationDate`.

## Step 9 — `AssignPossibleDuplicate` (soft match)
- **Side-effect:** unless `sharesHousehold` is true, flags `possibleDuplicate = true` and `possibleDuplicateOf = <earliest matching id>` when an existing non-deleted owner has a *different* identityKey but the *same* soundex(lastName) and postcode; otherwise sets `possibleDuplicate = false`.

## Step 10 — `SaveOwner`
- **Side-effect:** persists the owner via `OwnerRepository.save` (assigns the DB id).

## Step 11 — `RecordIdempotency`
- **Side-effect:** if the request carried an `Idempotency-Key`, records `key → owner.id` in the `IdempotencyStore` so a repeat replays this owner. No-op when no key.

## Step 12 — `AuditOwnerCreated`
- **Side-effect:** computes membership points and capped level; emits a human-readable audit line **and** a structured schema-v2 `OwnerCreatedEvent` JSON (allocating a monotonic app-wide `seq`) to the `AUDIT` logger.

## Step 13 — `EnqueueWelcomeNotification`
- **Side-effect:** emits a welcome line (`id`, `memberId`) to the `NOTIFY` logger.

## Step 14 — `RespondWithOwnerCreated`
- **Side-effect:** maps the owner to `OwnerDto` and sends **201 Created** with `Location: /api/owners/{id}`.

---

Two things worth flagging while reading it as-is:
- The idempotency replay in step 1 happens **before** body validation (step 2), so a replayed key returns the stored owner without re-validating the (possibly different) body.
- The `sharesHousehold` DTO doc says it bypasses duplicates for "same last name and postcode," but the actual hard check it bypasses (`EnsureUniqueIdentity`) keys on telephone + email + soundex(lastName), not last name + postcode — the last-name/postcode notion now only drives the *soft* match in step 9.
